changes.source: Warning mode accepts orders normally; it does not schedule their processing.

changes.source: Opening times are included; closing times are excluded. Overlapping ranges cannot be saved.

changes.after: Les heures d’ouverture sont incluses ; les heures de fermeture sont exclues. Les créneaux qui se chevauchent ne peuvent pas être enregistrés.

changes.source: Enter valid HH:MM times. Opening and closing must differ; use 00:00–24:00 for a full day.
